name: Monitor GDELT brand mentions daily, dedupe in Sheets, and email a digest

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow is for PR, comms, and brand teams who need a daily list of news mentions they can review — headlines with outlet, country, tone, and a link — not a raw GDELT dump. Each morning it reads article URLs already in your Google Sheet, then runs the GDELT News Monitor Apify actor for the keywords, languages, countries, and time span you set. It can label each article negative, neutral, or positive, optionally keep only a chosen tone, skips any URL already logged, normalizes the fields, and appends only the new rows. You get a Gmail digest with the count and an HTML table. If none qualify, you get a short all-clear. If the actor call fails, or another node errors, you get an email instead of a silent failure.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account. The free plan includes $5 of monthly platform credit. Create a Header Auth credential with name Authorization and value Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN.
2. Create a Google Sheet with a tab named Mentions and the headers in the Sheet headers note. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 and paste the sheet URL into both Sheets nodes.
3. Connect Gmail OAuth2. Set digestEmail in Set search settings, and use the same address on Email workflow error.
4. In workflow settings, set this workflow as its own Error Workflow.
5. Replace the sample keywords with your brand or topic, run once by hand, then activate. Each saved article costs $0.002. Keep maxItems modest so the actor finishes within the 5-minute sync limit. Sentiment labels make the run about three times longer.

### Customization
Edit keywords, languages, countries, excludeKeywords, timespan, maxItems, sentiment, and toneFilter in Set search settings. Set toneFilter to negative for adverse-media reviews. Change the 7:00 schedule to match your timezone.

## Configure the daily search
Edit keywords, languages, countries, timespan, max items, toneFilter, and digestEmail here. These values are the only ones most users need to change.

## Fetch new articles
Reads existing article URLs first so a sheet error does not spend Apify credit, then runs the actor. A failed actor call emails you on the lower branch.

## Filter and normalize mentions
Optionally keeps a chosen tone (for example only negative), skips URLs already in the sheet, and flattens fields for Sheets and the digest.

## Log and email the digest
Appends only new mentions. Emails an HTML table when there are new rows, or a short all-clear when the run finds none.

## Sheet headers
On tab `Mentions`, row 1: `url, title, domain, sourceCountry, language, seenAt, sentiment, toneRange, query, loggedAt`. Do not rename `url`.

## Handle unexpected errors
After import, set this workflow as its own Error Workflow so any unhandled failure (sheet auth, Gmail, and so on) emails you.

## Set your email before activating
Replace you@example.com in Set search settings (`digestEmail`) and in the To field of Email workflow error. Otherwise test emails go to the placeholder.

nodes.name: Set search settings
nodes.notes: keywords: comma-separated terms or phrases, for example artificial intelligence or Acme Corp. languages: comma-separated, for example english. countries: optional outlet countries, for example US,UK. excludeKeywords: optional terms to drop. timespan: how far back, for example 24h or 7d. maxItems: daily result and cost cap ($0.002 each). sentiment: true labels each article negative, neutral, or positive (about 3× slower). toneFilter: any, negative, positive, or non-neutral (applied after the actor; needs sentiment true). digestEmail: where the daily digest and actor-failure email are sent.
